name: Negative Gaussian Splatting
definition: A variant of Gaussian Splatting that incorporates negative Gaussians (ellipsoids with negative color values) as components of a joint family of tuples optimized to represent a 3D scene, allowing for the modeling of high-frequency elements and complex nonlinear structures.
summary: Negative Gaussian Splatting allows Gaussian primitives to have negative color values, enabling efficient modeling of complex nonlinear structures and shadows through density subtraction.
